test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Machinist) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about slotting tools is correct?

options.text: Slotting tools remove metal during the horizontal stroke of cutting.
Slotting tools are weaker than the material being cut to ensure easy machining.
Slotting tools have angles determined with respect to the horizontal plane.
Slotting tools have a front rake and clearance angles but no side rake angle.

solution:
The correct answer is __Slotting tools have a front rake and clearance angles but no side rake angle__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Slotting tools__ are cutting tools used for machining.
 
• They have a front rake angle that facilitates the cutting process.
 
• Slotting tools also possess clearance angles to ensure smooth operation without interference.
 
• Unlike other cutting tools, slotting tools lack a side rake angle.
 
• These tools remove material during the vertical stroke of the cutting process.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Slotting Machine:**

 
 
• A slotting machine is primarily used for cutting shapes or slots into a material.
 
• It works by moving the cutting tool vertically while the workpiece remains stationary.
 
 
 
• **Keyway Cutting:**
 
 
• Slotting machines are often used for creating keyways in gears or shafts.
 
• Keyways are essential for mechanical assemblies to transmit torque effectively.
 
 
 
• **Tool Angles:**
 
 
• The angles on cutting tools are designed to optimize efficiency and minimize wear.
 
• Proper angles ensure precise machining and reduce overheating.
